We did the tasting menu with wine pairing. The dishes were small portions, but a large number of them. My partner had to tap out as there was too much food for her. Not every course was the same for each of us, including the wine pairings. The pastas and steaks stood out as the best of the night. Just about everything was rich, lots of creme in the small bites for instance, living up to the name. I felt the wines were really nice. Really good variety of flavors, but the pairing themselves I wasn't so sure of. With some many rich dishes, the food had less range than the wines. Overall I think we would have had a better experience going with our own (fewer) selections.

Along with this seasonal favorite, Bao Bao Dumpling also offers a variety of dumplings, noodles, and other Chinese dishes to enjoy with family and friends. Make this Mid-Autumn celebration a little more delicious with something special from Geary Blvd in San Francisco.

We're asking for your help with something our Bayview community has been requesting for years: dinner service. Our goal is to pilot a new evening takeout and delivery program from 6 PM–10 PM, so you can finally enjoy Gumbo Social after work. This pilot would also make delivery available, bringing your favorite gumbo, po'boys, and more to even more people while helping create a livelier evening scene in Bayview. Your support will help us fund the equipment, safety upgrades, and staffing needed to launch this program, including a new takeout service window, security improvements, and the operational costs of testing extended hours.

I was skeptical at 1st because the photos I saw were from 2 and 3 years ago. I also wondered about the location. I decided. Eh, let me go check and see if it's still there and support a hustle. They're on Google so it can't be too bad and have been listed for years. I am SO glad I did. I tried the baked beans with turkey meat! Yum! The ribs and chicken, I always put sauce on my bbq. I forgot to add sauce but didn't think about it after I was washing my hands when done. Now if I tell you how picky I am about my Mac n cheese. I literally like NOBODY'S mac n cheese. I saw an old photo of his Mac n cheese and it looked baked so, again. I had to see for myself. I was so pleasantly surprised when I saw it was in fact baked AND IT WAS GOOD!!! To be fair. I do but Mac n cheese from almost everyone that sells it. Yeah. I just recently stopped after years of disappointment but took 1 last chance. I am so glad I did I spent $27 for a 2 meat plate with 2 screamin sides. Thank you for still being open AND having great food!

Join us this Easter and reserve your seat today.
Mar 27, 2026
